data_window_note: MMS L2 data ~90 days behind real-time

unusual_events.explanation: 112 electron holes (bipolar E∥ events) detected in 6 hours. This is unusually high activity, indicating an active or recently saturated two-stream instability. These phase-space vortices are the direct nonlinear saturation products of Langmuir wave trapping (Bernstein et al. 1957, Graham et al. 2016 GRL).

electron_holes.note: 112 bipolar E∥ events above 1.00 mV/m — consistent with nonlinear TSI saturation products (electron holes/phase-space vortices)

electrons.dfdv_note: v_beam/v_th = 0.01 < 1.5 → no bump-on-tail. Beam insufficient for classical TSI.
